description: This file defines the 'ProductPurchased' class within the OpenCart admin system. The class extends the base model engine and provides methods to retrieve purchased product data and total purchase counts, including filtering options such as date range and order status.

classes.name: ProductPurchased
classes.description: Model class responsible for retrieving purchased product data and purchase counts, with filtering capabilities.

methods.name: getPurchased
methods.description: Retrieves a list of purchased products with quantity and total sales, supporting filtering by order status, date range, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalPurchased
methods.description: Returns the total count of distinct products purchased, supporting filtering by order status and date range.
